name: witness_silent
about: One witness goes silent and comes back: both sign until 8 s, then Pi B signs nothing until 34 s. 15 s after its last signature (at 20 s) the record holds witness_silent for it and state.chain says 1 of 2; at 35 s it signs again, the record holds witness_back and state.chain says 2 of 2. The chain goes on throughout. Simulated.
